This Visit
Rooms reviewed: Master Bedroom, Master Bedroom Closet, Master Bathroom, Living Room, Balcony, Den, Laundry Room, Belisa's Bedroom, Foyer, Kitchen, plus items throughout the home
Decisions needed from you: None, everything is moving

Master Bedroom

All accessories, bedding, and kitchen items have been organized and categorized in this corner, so the installation will be easy when we are ready.
This is where all furniture pieces are being placed as they arrive.
Four boxes are stored here, two from Ricky's move and two lighting pieces ready to be installed when the furniture comes in. These include the foyer lamp, which will not be installed until all construction in the bathroom is completed.
The edge of the master bedroom wall has been left without wallpaper so it is not damaged during the bathroom construction. It will be installed once the bathroom construction is finished.
Ricky's master bedroom pendant light was opened and inspected, with no damage found. The handyman has been instructed to install it 70 inches from the floor to the bottom of the fixture. He has also been told to assemble all of the crystal and glass balls first, so the bottom of the fixture can be determined.

Master Bedroom Closet

The six rolls of wallpaper for the master bathroom are stored here, ready for when we wallpaper the master bathroom.

Master Bathroom

All rugs are being stored here as they arrive, including the foyer rug and the living room rug. We do not recommend putting them down yet.

Living Room

All audiovisual equipment found on the property has been gathered in this corner, next to the feature wall and the sliding doors to the balcony.
The ceiling electrical access for the ceiling lights has been removed, painted, and completed.
These are the boxes we opened and emptied today. The handyman has been asked to remove all trash and debris, along with the old table and the dining chair from the old set, which will not be used at the moment.

Balcony

The dining table is in place. The open area is waiting for the rest of the outdoor furniture, which is still to arrive.

Throughout

The handyman has started painting the trim in the correct color. We discussed with him that the trim should be a satin finish, as specified last week, and he will repaint it in the correct finish.
Trim painting is in progress. We also reminded the handyman to paint the ceiling sprinklers so all colors match.
The general contractor confirmed that the drawings being completed by the engineer are almost done. The next step is submitting everything to the city.

Den

The den has been organized for all plumbing and wallpaper items. We have received 100% of the wallpaper ordered. Belisa's bedroom is up next, and we will hold the guest bathroom until its construction is done, just as we are doing with the master bathroom wallpaper.

Laundry Room

The handyman has raised the cabinets and installed the ceiling light.

Belisa's Bedroom

Belisa's bedroom, which Ricky is using for now. His bed pillow has been placed on the bed.

Foyer

All boxes addressed to Belisa or Ricky are being placed here so they can see what they are. We have also left the kitchen appliance and the pots and pans here, to avoid creating a mess in the kitchen while it is not yet remodeled.
Some of the wallpaper at the front door was painted during the trim painting. We have pointed this out to the handyman so he can clean off the paint, and asked him to make sure no further wallpaper is painted.

Kitchen

The handyman was in the process of installing the kitchen pendants. We have given him the installation height, 32 inches from the top of the counter to the bottom of the fixture.
